title: A boon by anger or austerity
literal_meaning: A boon through anger; otherwise, a boon through austerity.
meaning_odia: କୋପ ପ୍ରକାଶ କରି ହେଉ ବା ତପସ୍ୟା କରି ହେଉ, ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ହେଉଛି ବର ପାଇବା। ଉତ୍ସର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଦେବତାଙ୍କଠାରୁ ବର ଲାଭର କଥା କହେ; ଉକ୍ତିଟି ଏକ ଫଳ ପାଇଁ ଦୁଇ ଭିନ୍ନ ପଥକୁ ପାଖାପାଖି ରଖିଛି।
explanation: The desired boon stays the same while the means change. The inspected gloss places the contrast in seeking a boon from deities, either through a display of anger or through austerity. More broadly, the wording can suggest trying contrasting approaches to secure the same result.
usage_example: In a fictional discussion, someone first presses an angry demand, then offers to undertake a difficult task to obtain the same concession. A listener recalls the saying about two routes to one boon. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: ବର means a granted boon in the inspected source’s religious frame. କୋପ and ତପ are paired by sound, setting anger beside ascetic effort while repeating the desired reward.

witnesses.locator: Page12, single line beginning କୋପେ ବର.
